grammarName.en: too much / too many / enough · so / such
grammarName.ru: too much / too many / enough · so / such

scenario: Kate has planned so many team-buildings that there is no time to actually work — a gentle complaint episode built on quantifiers, too/enough and so/such. Den grumbles, 'There are too many meetings and not enough time.' Alex yawns, 'So much coffee, so little sleep.' Pol says, 'There isn't enough fruit for all these smoothies.' Kate insists, 'It's such a good idea! We are such a great team!' Peter counts: 'We have too much cake and too many emails.' In the end Kate agrees to cancel one meeting, and everyone cheers — 'Finally, enough time to work!' Warm, funny office complaining, nobody is really upset. Use clear patterns: too much/too many/(not) enough + noun, too + adjective, so + adjective, such (a) + noun, so much/so many. Short B1 sentences.
